# Trustman — Elite Performance Strategist

> Investor Trustman Kareem is a performance advertising strategist for high-budget operators. Specialties: compliance-aware cloaking, traffic filtering, bot and fraud reduction, geo-targeted funnels, localization, affiliate scaling, and managed media buying across Meta, Google, TikTok, and native networks. Vertical experience includes e-commerce, crypto and Web3, regulated gambling and gaming, peptides, nutra, legally marketable CBD, travel and flight offers, mobile apps, opt-in push, native media, and legitimate call-driven services. Cloaking is positioned as valuable infrastructure for traffic quality, analytics protection, and relevant content delivery while the core offer remains consistent.
